INC_INC_011.name: Median weekly household income from collected sources, selected household population
INC_INC_011.population_group: Survey households with at least one member aged 18–64; households with all members outside those ages are excluded, including all-65+ households. Total regions and household types within that population.
INC_INC_011.period_convention: June-quarter weekly-income snapshot collected during April–June. Not annual household income; weekly values must not be multiplied by 52 to imply an annual estimate. Some source components (self-employment) use the preceding 12 months, as described by the publisher.
INC_INC_011.income_basis: The June 2026 publication explicitly describes individual income as gross before tax. Exact household-table aggregation/basis remains a semantic check; do not turn that individual sentence into an unqualified household basis assertion.
INC_INC_011.rounding: Published means/medians rounded to nearest NZD; hourly figures nearest cent.
INC_INC_011.missing_value_meaning: S denotes suppression of estimates representing fewer than 1,000 people; never numeric zero.
INC_INC_011.verification_limit: Retained 202606 value 2438 lacks a separately presented exact official cell. This metadata fix does not certify it.

CORR_FIS_005.period_convention: Fiscal year ended 30 June; 2025 means 2024/25. A calendar-year release is not a replacement for this selected fiscal series.
CORR_FIS_005.publication_status: Stats NZ announced on 11 September 2026 that fiscal-year prison releases are discontinued; calendar-year releases continue. The last selected fiscal observation may remain unchanged legitimately.

PRD_PRD_001.index_reference: Year ended March 1996 = 1000; measured sector, not whole-economy labour productivity.
PRD_PRD_001.period_convention: Year ended March; 2025 result is provisional in the dated 23 April 2026 release.

JUS_FIS_001.period_convention: Fiscal year ended 30 June; 2025 means 2024/25. Calendar-year observations cannot silently replace this series.
JUS_FIS_001.publication_status: Stats NZ announced on 11 September 2026 that fiscal-year criminal-conviction/sentencing releases are discontinued; calendar-year releases continue.

reader_plumbing: lib/stats-nz.js currently copies population_group but no other proposed fields. Root may expose explicit supported series metadata additively; the evidence worker has not edited runtime files. Preserve reference periods/codes and refusal behaviour.
income_caution: The official June 2026 headline median wage/salary earnings is 1419, whereas INC_INC_001 target is 1391. Exact table population/measure and source vintage have not been reconciled; do not label this a demonstrated numerical defect or substitute the headline.
